verdict.rationale: Otter documents a first-party MCP Server that connects meeting data to AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT. The blog describes OAuth authentication with granular permissions and capabilities including transcript search and cross-meeting analysis, and the integrations page and probe confirm the Claude MCP connection. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, detailed setup and tool-reference documentation beyond marketing and blog copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Otter's MCP Server connects your meeting data directly to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, bringing your meeting intelligence into your everyday AI workflows.
Connect Otter.ai meeting transcripts and action items to Claude via MCP. Search, recap, and draft follow-ups without leaving the chat.
OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions. Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize
ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI chat tools can securely access your meeting knowledge through Otter's MCP Server for deeper analysis and smarter workflows.
